'''Andar Sizzton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He operated with the team of hunters led by [[Zinn Classet]], who were contracted to track down a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives for the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]] for freeing one of their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Kentara]]. Sizzton tracked the group as the traveled aboard the ''[[Trax Express]]'' from [[Draenell's Point]] to [[Entrus]].
